wf.title: Workflows
wf.desc: A workflow is a saved plan of steps an agent runs. Run one from its page or from a chat.
wf.allRealms.title: Pick a realm to see its workflows
wf.allRealms.body: Workflows belong to one realm. Choose a realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square). All runs shows the runs of every realm.
wf.empty.title: No workflows yet
wf.empty.body: Make one with New workflow: describe it and a chat writes it, or write its source yourself. Workflows that come with a project show here too.
wf.paused.title: Workflows cannot be read while agents on {{computer}} are paused
wf.paused.body: They show again when the agents resume.
wf.gone: This workflow is no longer on {{computer}}.
wf.unreachable.title: Not reached from the start
wf.col.name: Name
wf.other.title: Reached by a route not shown here
wf.detailFailed: Couldn't read this workflow's answer routes
wf.originTip.yours: Saved on this computer by you or an agent.
wf.originTip.system: Shipped with the agent. You can hide it, not delete it.
wf.originTip.customized: A shipped workflow you changed. Reset brings the shipped one back.
wf.hiddenTip: The agent doesn't see this workflow. You still can.
wf.stepsInfo: Each step sits below the steps that lead to it, except one that goes back to it. Lettered steps (3a, 3b) share a row.
wf.firstUse.title: Nothing to show for this workflow yet
wf.firstUse.body: Its steps, runs and settings show here once the agent lists them.
wf.kindTip.bash: Runs a shell command on the computer.
wf.kindTip.agent: An agent does this step, with the instructions written for it.
wf.kindTip.fork: A copy of the agent running the workflow does this step, knowing what it knows so far.
wf.kindTip.tool: Calls one of the agent's tools directly, with no agent deciding.
wf.kindTip.workflow: Runs another workflow as one step.
wf.kindTip.foreach: Runs once for each item in a list.
